WITH matches AS (
    SELECT match_id FROM main."match" WHERE season_id = 5
), scores AS (
    SELECT s.match_id, b.striker, s.runs_scored, pm.player_id
    FROM matches AS m
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s ON s.match_id = m.match_id
    LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b
      ON (b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.ball_id) =
         (s.match_id, s.innings_no, s.over_id, s.ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.player_match AS pm ON pm.match_id = s.match_id AND pm.player_id = b.striker
)
SELECT 'score records', COUNT(*) FROM scores
UNION ALL SELECT 'unattributed or missing runs', COUNT(*) FROM scores WHERE striker IS NULL OR player_id IS NULL OR runs_scored IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'appearances', COUNT(*) FROM matches JOIN main.player_match USING (match_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'striker appearances with scores', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT match_id, striker FROM scores GROUP BY match_id, striker)
UNION ALL SELECT w.kind_out, COUNT(*) FROM matches JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id) GROUP BY w.kind_out

arguments.sql:
WITH season_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id
    FROM main."match"
    WHERE season_id = 5
),
runs_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker AS player_id, SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s
      ON s.match_id = b.match_id AND s.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND s.over_id = b.over_id AND s.ball_id = b.ball_id
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT pm.player_id, COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.runs, 0)) AS total_runs
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.player_match AS pm ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    LEFT JOIN runs_by_match AS r
      ON r.match_id = pm.match_id AND r.player_id = pm.player_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT w.player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS times_out
    FROM season_matches AS m
    JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY w.player_out
)
SELECT p.player_name, t.matches_played, t.total_runs, d.times_out,
       1.0 * t.total_runs / t.matches_played AS runs_per_match
FROM player_totals AS t
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = t.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = t.player_id
ORDER BY runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 6
